<description>
Part of #36692. Follow-up to #36750

Replaces field-by-field construction of inputs and outputs with `COutPoint`, `CTxIn` and `CTxOut` ctor calls in `txpackage_tests`, `bench/duplicate_inputs` and `script_p2sh_tests`.

`CMutableTransaction` is kept as the builder while a `CTransaction` constructor is discussed in #36696. Witnesses are still assigned after `vin`, since `CTxIn` has no witness argument yet.

Test-only; the constructed transactions are unchanged.

- `script_p2sh_tests`: two outputs created by `vout.resize(1)` never had a value, so their null `nValue` (`-1`) is now explicit.
- Intentional mutations are left as they are: the `scriptSig` swap in `sign`, the dummy signing in `ValidateInputsStandardness`, and the witness-only copies in `txpackage_tests` (`mtx_child2`, `mtx_parent2_v2`).
</description>

<commits>
5336eaa7fa test: construct txpackage_tests inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace the field-by-field construction of the inputs and outputs in
create_placeholder_tx, mtx_child1 and mtx_parent2_v1 with COutPoint,
CTxIn and CTxOut constructor calls.

As in BuildSpendingTransaction, the scriptWitness assignment must come
after vin is replaced, since CTxIn has no witness constructor argument.

In create_placeholder_tx, the random values are drawn in the same order
as before, so the placeholder transactions are unchanged.

The constructed transactions are unchanged.

7fc7d26e75 bench: construct duplicate_inputs inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace the field-by-field construction of the coinbase input and
output, and of the naughtyTx output, in DuplicateInputs with COutPoint,
CTxIn and CTxOut constructor calls.

The constructed transactions are unchanged.

a4a2647834 test: construct script_p2sh_tests inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace field-by-field construction of inputs and outputs with
COutPoint, CTxIn and CTxOut constructor calls.

Outputs previously created by vout.resize() without a value now spell
out the null nValue (-1) explicitly. Loop indices become uint32_t to
match COutPoint::n, since brace-initialization rejects the narrowing.

The scriptSig mutations after signing are intentional and kept.

The constructed transactions are unchanged.
</commits>
